about.title: About Ultimate Physique
about.subtitle: Scientific fitness assessment — track progress with data, train like leveling up.
about.missionBody: We build scientific, transparent, reproducible fitness scoring so you can see your level clearly — and make everyday training feel like leveling up in a game.
about.founderStory: Inspired by Arnold Schwarzenegger and Bruce Lee since childhood, I began self-training at age 10 — but without scientific guidance, progress stayed out of reach. In college, at 180 cm / 55 kg with severely low BMI, I learned how costly unguided training can be. I then trained under the US Northwest Regional MMA Champion. Over 2.5 years I gained 28 kg (to 83 kg) while keeping body fat under 12%. That transformation set me on the path of exercise science and coaching — and became the spark for Ultimate Physique.
founderCredentials: Muay Thai National Team Conditioning Coach
Basketball National Team Strength & Conditioning Coach
Coaching since 2012; 500+ athletes coached with 25,000+ teaching hours
about.founderVisionLead: Combining a business-management background with exercise-science expertise, I built the Ultimate Physique assessment system. Through data-driven, scientific evaluation, everyone can:
founderVisionGoals: Set specific and achievable training goals
Compete positively with fitness enthusiasts worldwide
Make fitness training fun like leveling up in a game
about.founderClosing: Let the data speak — let's get stronger together.
